newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada July retail sales rise 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada July retail sales rise 0.2 pct.

text.p: Canadian retail sales rose 0.2 percent in July to a seasonally adjusted C$17.98 billion from C$17.94 billion in June, revised from C$17.97 billion, Statistics Canada said on Friday.
Sales, ex vehicles, s/a +0.5 +1.2 C$13.72 bln
A Reuter survey of economists had forecast that seasonally adjusted retail sales would rise by 0.2 percent in July.
The agency said early indications for August pointed to a rise.
Statistics Canada said sales rose over the month in the food, drug and clothing sectors. Declines in the automotive sector limited the gain in total sales.
(For more information from Statistics Canada, contact the Retail Trade Section, Industry Division, Pierre Desjardins at 613-951-9682).
